type.description: Specifies whether metrics are returned using `5m` or `1h` intervals

beginTimestamp.description: The earliest timestamp to retrieve data from (RFC3339 format)

endTimestamp.description: The latest timestamp to retrieve data up to (RFC3339 format)

duration.description: Specifies the time range of metrics to retrieve, starting from when the request is made. Supports `24h` for 5-minute metrics, and `7d` or `30d` for 1-hour metrics. This parameter **cannot** be used with `beginTimestamp` or `endTimestamp`.

hostIds[].description: List of host IDs to filter the results

time.description: Last processed timestamp of devices in RFC3339 format

pageSize.description: Number of items to return per page

nextToken.description: Token for pagination to retrieve the next set of results
